title: Medical Virtual Assistant (MVA)
description:
Medical Virtual Assistant (MVA)

Remote | Chiropractic Clinic | 30 Hours/Week | $6/Hour
Position Overview
We are seeking a highly capable Medical Virtual Assistant (MVA) to support the overall operational health of a busy healthcare clinic. This role is ideal for someone who is very sharp, proactive, detail-oriented, emotionally intelligent, and able to take ownership of important clinic workflows with minimal supervision.
This is not a basic task-following role. The ideal candidate must be able to think ahead , identify operational gaps, take initiative, and help remove administrative and billing-related tasks from the provider's plate.
We are looking for someone with excellent English communication skills, strong executive presence, high accountability, and the ability to build a trust-based working relationship with the provider and care team.
Key Responsibilities
Insurance Verification
Verify patient insurance after the patient checks in, typically around 15 minutes after the scheduled appointment time. Ensure all insurance information is accurate, updated, and properly documented.
Denied Claims Management
Review denied claims, identify denial reasons, and assist with claim reprocessing. Track issues, follow up on missing information, and help prevent repeat claim errors.
EOB Processing
Review and process Explanation of Benefits documents. Help organize, validate, and clear EOB backlogs while ensuring billing and insurance documentation is accurate.
Patient Balance Resolution
Review outstanding insurance balances and patient account issues. Track unresolved balances, identify the source of the issue, and coordinate next steps for resolution.
Claims Processing
Support claims-related workflows, including Cigna and Veterans Affairs claims. Ensure claims are reviewed, tracked, and escalated when necessary.
Payment Coordination
Assist with vendor payment coordination, including check payments when needed. Ensure payment-related tasks are completed accurately and on time.
SOAP Note Monitoring
Monitor SOAP note completion, accuracy, and compliance. Track missing, incomplete, or delayed documentation and communicate concerns appropriately.
Appointment Tracking
Track missed appointments, canceled appointments, and scheduling trends. Identify patterns that may affect clinic revenue, patient flow, or provider productivity.
Reports and Operational Tracking
Prepare reports on outstanding balances, missed appointments, canceled appointments, EOB backlog, denied claims, and other operational metrics. Reports should include clear insights and practical recommendations when needed.
Team Coordination
Support smooth communication between the provider, care team, and administrative staff. Help ensure updates are clearly shared, priorities are followed through, and important tasks are not missed.
Operational Support
Proactively identify workflow gaps, billing concerns, documentation delays, scheduling issues, and patient account problems. Recommend practical solutions to improve clinic efficiency.
Mandatory Requirements

• Minimum of 1 year of experience as a Medical Virtual Assistant

• Experience supporting a US healthcare practice

• Experience with insurance verification, EOBs, claims, denied claims, patient balances, or billing support

• Exposure to CPT and ICD-10 codes

• Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal

• Strong executive presence and professional communication style

• Must be a Mac OS user

• Strong attention to detail and follow-through

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

• Proven leadership, ownership, or high-accountability experience in a previous role

Required Soft Skills

• Proactive and able to anticipate needs before being asked

• Highly detail-oriented with billing, documentation, and reporting tasks

• Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

• Emotionally intelligent and patient when working with a busy provider

• Confident, professional, and organized in c

description:
Materials Science Expert
Pay: $80-$130/hour
Location: Global, fully remote
Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)
Schedule: Flexible-you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired
We are looking for a highly skilled Materials Science Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving computational materials science, materials modeling, scientific simulation, and Python.
The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks related to material structures, properties, processing, performance, and failure. A representative task may require constructing a material or atomic model, configuring and running a simulation, calculating relevant properties, analyzing the resulting outputs, and determining whether the solution is computationally valid and physically meaningful.
This role requires both strong materials expertise and experience using engineering or scientific tools programmatically. Experience limited exclusively to graphical user interfaces will not be sufficient, as task solutions must be reproducible through code, scripts, configuration files, or command-line tools.
What You’ll Work On

• Solve and validate computational materials-science and materials-engineering problems.

• Create material structures, atomic configurations, compositions, and solver-ready inputs.

• Model relationships between composition, structure, processing, properties, and performance.

• Run atomistic, electronic-structure, molecular-dynamics, continuum, electrochemical, or related simulations.

• Use Python to generate inputs, automate calculations, conduct parameter sweeps, process results, and validate outputs.

• Analyze mechanical, thermal, electrical, chemical, structural, or electrochemical properties.

• Diagnose failed calculations, invalid structures, convergence problems, numerical instability, and incorrect physical assumptions.

• Compare computational results with experimental data, literature values, known properties, or expected physical trends.

• Review AI-generated solutions for scientific correctness and identify invalid assumptions, configurations, or conclusions.

• Develop reproducible reference solutions and objective verification methods.

Required Qualifications

• An MS or PhD in Materials Science and Engineering, Metallurgy, or a closely related discipline; or

• An MS or PhD in Mechanical Engineering or Chemical Engineering with a substantial materials specialization.

• Strong understanding of materials behavior and relevant structure-property relationships.

• Experience with computational materials modeling, simulation, characterization, or materials-focused engineering analysis.

• Practical proficiency with Python .

• Experience with at least one engineering or scientific tool that can be operated through a CLI, scripting interface, configuration files, or programmatic API.

• Ability to understand and justify modeling assumptions, parameters, approximations, and convergence criteria.

• Ability to distinguish computational failures from genuine physical behavior.

• Ability to explain complex scientific reasoning and technical limitations clearly.

Relevant tools may include LAMMPS, ASE, pymatgen, Quantum ESPRESSO, FEniCSx, CalculiX, Elmer, PyBaMM , or similar programmatic materials and simulation software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.
Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter , atomistic modeling packages, materials informatics libraries, or domain-specific scientific tools. No single library is mandatory.
Experience may come from academic research, national laboratories, industry R&D, computational engineering, or other demonstrated materials work.
Process

• Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.

• Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.

• Complete a technical assessment, if required.

• Complete the hiring manager review.

AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Junior Electronics Test & Hardware Engineer to support the design, development, validation, and integration of electronic test equipment and hardware systems. The role will contribute to the development and production of advanced satellite systems by ensuring reliable testing, verification, and qualification of electronic products and assemblies.

Key Responsibilities:

· Design and develop electronic hardware for test equipment, validation activities, and testing systems.
· Design, build, and integrate Acceptance and Qualification Racks (RACs) and test benches.
· Create, update, and maintain technical documentation and design files.
· Develop test procedures and support test automation activities.
· Assemble, wire, and integrate electronic systems and test equipment.
· Execute hardware validation, verification, and functional testing activities.
· Diagnose, analyze, and resolve issues detected during integration and testing phases.
· Analyze test results and prepare technical reports.
· Collaborate with engineering and production teams to support industrialization and deployment of new solutions.
· Act as technical liaison with PCB manufacturing and assembly suppliers.
· Identify improvement opportunities and propose technical solutions to optimize products and processes.

Qualifications

Education:
Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Electronics Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Industrial Engineering (Electronics specialization), Automation & Robotics Engineering, or a related field.

Experience:
A minimum of 2 years of experience in electronic design, hardware validation, testing, or related engineering positions.

Preferred Qualifications:
· Experience designing and developing PCBs.
· Experience with test rack, test bench, or similar test system development.
· Experience working with PCB manufacturing and assembly suppliers.
· Experience with test automation and programming for validation activities.

Soft Skills:
· Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
· Hands-on approach with the ability to work effectively in laboratory and engineering environments.
· Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
· Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
· Good technical communication and documentation skills.

Technology Stack:
· Electronic hardware design tools.
· PCB design and development.
· Test automation tools and programming environments.
· Laboratory instrumentation (oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, analyzers, and measurement equipment).
· Electronic schematics and technical documentation.
· Electronic integration, validation, and testing systems.

Physical Requirements

· Ability to work in both office and laboratory environments.
· Ability to use a computer and laboratory equipment for extended periods.
· Ability to assemble, wire, and integrate electronic hardware and test systems.
· Ability to occasionally handle test equipment and electronic components.

title: Staff Applications Engineer
description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Staff Applications Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $150,000-$190,000 Annually
Experience Required: 10+ Years
Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

We are seeking a highly experienced Staff Applications Engineer with 10+ years of professional software engineering experience to provide deep technical leadership across multiple engineering teams and drive the design and execution of complex, cross-functional initiatives. As a Staff Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in defining technical strategy, shaping architecture, establishing engineering best practices, and delivering scalable, high-quality software solutions that support long-term business objectives.
Key Responsibilities

•

• Extensive experience with system architecture, software design patterns, scalability, reliability, and performance optimization.

title: Capacity Strategy & Operations
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

As a member of the Capacity Strategy & Operations team, you will sit at the intersection of supply intelligence, demand forecasting, and cross-functional execution, turning a complex, fast-moving hardware market into a predictable, reliable foundation for our customers and internal engineering teams.

This is not a purely analytical role. You will own the end-to-end capacity planning process: from translating customer commitments and growth forecasts into concrete supply requirements, to coordinating fulfillment across vendors, finance, and the infrastructure team, to building the systems that make all of this repeatable and scalable. When supply is constrained and tradeoffs are unavoidable, you are the person in the room who can model the options, make a clear recommendation, and drive alignment fast.

You are a strong fit if you have operated at the intersection of strategy and execution before - someone who is equally comfortable building a capacity model in a spreadsheet and running a cross-functional war room when a customer deployment is at risk.

EXAMPLE INITIATIVES

- Demand-Supply Alignment Framework: Build and own the process that translates customer pipeline, signed commitments, and growth projections into a forward-looking GPU demand signal - so the team is never caught flat-footed when a customer scales faster than expected.

- Constrained Allocation Playbook: Define the decision framework for how Baseten allocates scarce GPU supply across competing customers and regions, including escalation paths and tradeoff criteria for leadership.

- Capacity War Room Ownership: Lead cross-functional response when a high-stakes capacity situation arises - coordinating across Sales, SRE, Finance, and Vendor relationships to resolve it with minimal customer disruption.

- Strategic Briefings for Leadership: Produce clear, concise capacity health reports and scenario analyses for senior leadership, enabling confident decisions on customer commitments, vendor negotiations, and CapEx allocation.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own the capacity planning process end to end: intake, triage, prioritization, fulfillment tracking, and post-mortem learnings

- Translate customer commitments, sales pipeline, and infrastructure growth targets into concrete GPU demand forecasts across regions, GPU types, and timelines

- Partner with Finance to model capacity scenarios, evaluate new supply opportunities, and support CapEx decision-making

- Work closely with the Capacity Acquisition team to align supply procurement with forward demand, flagging gaps and risks early

- Coordinate cross-functionally across Sales, SRE, and Infrastructure teams to resolve capacity conflicts and ensure customer commitments are honored

- Build and maintain the operational cadence that keeps capacity planning structured, visible, and free of ad-hoc Slack chaos

- Develop reporting and dashboards that give leadership a real-time view of capacity health, utilization trends, and risk exposure

- Identify recurring operational gaps in the capacity lifecycle and drive process improvements that reduce toil and improve reliability

REQUIREMENTS

- 5+ years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, finance, or a similarly analytical and execution-oriented role

- Demonstrated ability to own complex, cross-functional processes with multiple stakeholders and competin

title: Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist
description:
Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist
Remote | Personal Injury | Part-Time, 30 hours/week initially | $6.5/hour

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized, dependable, and personable Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist to support a growing personal injury medical practice.
The immediate priority for this role is addressing a significant backlog of patient follow-up calls. You will conduct outbound outreach, document patient recovery progress, support attorney and legal documentation requests, and help ensure that tasks are completed accurately and on time.
The ideal candidate combines strong medical assistant experience with excellent communication, persistence, accuracy, and the ability to handle sensitive patient and legal information with a very high level of attention to detail.
Key Responsibilities
Patient Follow-Up & Outreach

• Contact patients approximately 4 to 6 weeks after their visit to check on their recovery and current condition.

• Conduct consistent outbound outreach through calls, texts, or other approved channels while remaining professional and respectful.

• Follow up persistently when patients are difficult to reach without becoming overly aggressive or pushy.

Symptom Tracking & Documentation

• Complete structured follow-up questionnaires regarding symptoms such as headaches, dizziness, and other reported concerns.

• Record patient responses accurately in the practice's dedicated symptom tracking database.

• Maintain complete and organized documentation so the physician can easily review patient recovery progress.

Legal Records & Billing Requests

• Respond to requests from attorneys and law firms for patient evaluations, medical records, and billing documentation.

• Compile the correct records and ensure all requested information is complete before sending or uploading it.

Portal & Task Management

• Upload completed evaluations, records, bills, and other requested documentation into designated attorney or client portals.

• Track outstanding requests and completed tasks so documentation does not fall through the cracks.

• Maintain organized records across the clinic's internal systems and external portals.

Reporting & Operational Reliability

• Provide End-of-Day reports summarizing completed calls, outreach attempts, pending follow-ups, and finished tasks.

• Maintain consistent follow-through on assigned responsibilities and communicate quickly when an issue could affect completion.

• Prioritize accuracy and reliability, particularly when handling patient records, legal requests, and time-sensitive documentation.

Cross-Training & Practice Support

• Learn the Scheduling & Intake Specialist's core workflows, including scheduling, patient intake, and patient communication.

• Provide backup coverage when the other VMA is unavailable or when patient volume increases.

• Assist with incoming calls, emails, patient questions, or administrative work when additional practice support is required.

• Fully fluent in English and Spanish .

• Previous experience as a Medical Assistant, Medical Receptionist, Virtual Medical Assistant, or similar healthcare support professional .

• Strong understanding of medical terminology and patient communication.

• Exceptional attention to detail when entering records or managing documentation.

• Strong telephone communication skills with a warm, conversational, and patient-centered approach.

• Comfortable performing frequent outbound patient calls and follow-ups.

• Highly organized and capable of independently tracking multiple open tasks.

• Able to work consistently during Mountain Time business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

• Previous experience working with personal injury practices.

title: Machine Learning Engineer III (Applied Research & Model Development)
description:

Our platform promises substantial improvements to the accuracy of diagnosis and the efficacy of treatment of diseases like cancer, leveraging modern approaches in machine learning and artificial intelligence. We have a track record of success in deploying AI algorithms for histopathology in translational research, pathology labs and clinical trials. Rigorous science and careful analysis is critical to the success of everything we do. Our team, composed of diverse employees with a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, is passionate about solving challenging problems and making a huge impact on patient outcomes.
The Opportunity
We are seeking Machine Learning Engineers (Applied Research & Model Development) to tackle unique machine learning challenges to advance medicine and improve patient care. You will work closely with teams across biomedical data science, product development, translational research, MLOps, and platform engineering to develop and deploy machine learning models for our AI products and services.
You will have the opportunity to work in a company where all employees put patients first. We believe that every team member provides valuable contributions to our success, and no task is too small for anyone if it's important to our company goals. Every PathAI employee is a contributor to our mission to pioneer better patient care by providing the best, most innovative AI tools to biotech, pathologists, clinicians and healthcare organizations. You will work alongside and with leading innovators in the field of AI and medicine and you will play a critical role in product development to impact patient outcomes.

• You will design, develop, and deploy machine learning models for research and product development projects.

• You will contribute to experimental design and analysis, including ideation, documentation, and reporting.

• You will participate in knowledge sharing and team initiatives (e.g., design reviews, journal clubs, ML best practices, governance activities).

(Required)

• You have demonstrated the ability to collaborate across scientific and engineering teams.

Preferred:

• You have excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects efficiently.

title: Director, Quantitative Systems Pharmacology
description:
At Eisai , satisfying unmet medical needs and increasing the benefits healthcare provides to patients, their families, and caregivers is Eisai ’s human health care (hhc) mission. We’re a growing pharmaceutical company that is breaking through in neurology and oncology, with a strong emphasis on research and development. Our history includes the development of many innovative medicines, notably the discovery of the world's most widely-used treatment for Alzheimer’s disease. As we continue to expand, we are seeking highly-motivated individuals who want to work in a fast-paced environment and make a difference.If this is your profile, we want to hear from you.
The Director of Quantitative Systems Pharmacology (QSP) will lead the development and implementation of mechanistic knowledge of biology integrated into mathematical models that support drug discovery and clinical development. The Director of QSP will provide scientific leadership, define QSP strategies, and collaborate across Eisai ’s Deep Human Biology Learning (DHBL) project teams to translate existing knowledge and data into actionable QSP models. These models will provide functional understanding of complex nonlinear pathophysiological systems and their interactions, will allow scientists to explore system dynamics and biological hypotheses, will yield insight into responses to different pharmacological approaches to modulating biological systems, and will provide mechanistic insights to inform Eisai ’s R&D decisions (for example FIH translation, dose selection, candidate selection, selection of target population, and combination strategies). This Director QSP position is essential for supporting the increasing expectations of team leaders and global regulators of applying QSP methodologies to continuously improve the conceptual and mechanistic understanding of the relations among drug exposure, efficacy, and safety. Essential Functions:

• Develop, implement, and apply QSP models to understand diseases, their pathways, and their progressions. Evaluate DHBL drug candidates and treatment modalities to predict their effects and optimize therapeutic strategies (e.g., the selection of target tumor types and populations), and to support clinical introduction including first-in-human dose selection.

• Use and improve existing Neurology QSP Platforms to gain insights into the causal relationships between biological and drug-level responses, enhancing the understanding of drug-target interactions and disease mechanisms. Develop new QSP models and platforms as they are needed.

• Lead DHBL preclinical and early clinical QSP development strategy to support optimal dose selection with simulations based on mechanistic understanding to assess efficacy and safety.

• Advocate for model-informed drug discovery and development (MIDD) approaches. Provide scientific leadership, present research at scientific conferences, and integrate MIDD strategies into Eisai ’s R&D programs to improve efficiency and decision-making.

• Foster collaboration across functional groups and promote the development of new modeling tools and methods. Advance the adoption of QSP capabilities to improve the predictive power of these tools to support the design and optimization of drug combinations.

• Manage the expectations/timelines of assigned M&S work for the relevant project teams.

• Use mathematical, computational, and statistical tools to analyze and interpret large, complex data sets to gain insights into the causal relationships between drug-target interactions and disease mechanisms.

• Provide scientific/strategic expertise across multiple therapeutic areas to support decision-making in the conversion of discovery to clinical through the design, development, and execution of quantitative mechanistic models to support the translational process.

Requirements:

• PhD, MD-PhD and/or PharmD in Bioengineering, Systems Biology, Applied Mathematics, Computational Biology, Pharmacometrics, Chemical Engine

From our genre-defining games like Magic: The Gathering® and Dungeons & Dragons® to our growing multiverse, we continue to innovate and build new ways to foster friendship and connection. That’s where you come in!

 

The cloud platform underpins how services are built, deployed, secured, and operated across the organization.

 

As a Principal Cloud Infrastructure Engineer, you will define and drive the governance model and automation strategy for cloud infrastructure. This includes setting policy-as-code standards, automating compliance and cost controls, and ensuring infrastructure is provisioned and operated through consistent, auditable, self-service pathways rather than tailored or manual processes.

 

You will operate at both a strategic and hands-on level and will set direction for how cloud resources are governed and automated while also building the tooling and guardrails that make that direction real. Success in this role means engineering teams can self-service the build and operation of infrastructure with confidence that it is secure, cost-aware, and consistent by default, without slowing delivery down.

 

What you'll do

Cloud Governance

• Define and enforce policy-as-code standards (tagging, naming, encryption, network segmentation, access boundaries) across cloud accounts/subscriptions

• Establish guardrails using tools such as OPA, Sentinel, AWS Config/Service Control Policies to report on and prevent drift from approved patterns

• Partner closely with Security/IAM to deliver least-privilege enforcement and access-control requirements directly in our self-service capabilities while ensuring compliance and auditability.

• Embed cost governance and reporting (budgets, anomaly detection, showback/chargeback) into provisioning workflows

 

Automation & Infrastructure as Code

• Drive the organization's Infrastructure-as-Code standards (e.g., Terraform/Terraform Cloud, Pulumi)

• Establish and maintain reusable, versioned modules and contribution standards that embed governance requirements by default.

• Automate environment provisioning, drift detection/remediation, and lifecycle management so policy compliance doesn't depend on manual review

• Stay ahead of AI-native tooling and bring forward practical opportunities balancing risk, fit, value, measurability, and alignment to company goals.

 

Platform & Developer Enablement

• Develop golden paths for infrastructure provisioning and service deployment that make the guided path the easiest path

• Partner on developer platform tooling and integrations (CI/CD, container registries, managed data services, observability) where they intersect with governance and automation.

 

What you'll bring

Experience & Skills

• 8+ years in cloud engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering, including experience operating at a principal or staff level (setting direction, not just implementing)

• Deep experience with major Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), ideally across more than one

• Deep hands-on experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform and/or Pulumi) at scale, including module design and state/workspace management

• Direct experience implementing policy-as-code and cloud governance frameworks

• Experience with cloud cost management/FinOps practices and tooling

• Familiarity with CI/CD platforms, container registries, and observability tooling as consumers of the standard

title: Senior Pre-Sales Systems Engineer, Higher Education (Mid-Atlantic)
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Everpure (formerly Pure Storage) is hiring a Senior Pre-Sales Systems Engineer to support our Higher Education business, with a focus on R1 research universities.

R1 institutions are not one customer. A single campus can behave like a dozen different organizations at the same time: central IT running enterprise applications, research computing and HPC teams, genomics and imaging cores, AI and machine learning labs competing for GPU time, an academic medical center with its own rules and its own budget, and faculty groups buying infrastructure directly with grant money. Decisions move through CIOs, research computing directors, principal investigators, sponsored programs offices, procurement, and consortium contract vehicles, often in parallel and not always in agreement.

That environment rewards someone who can hold a lot of context at once, translate between very different audiences, and connect technology to the outcomes these institutions actually care about: time to result for researchers, compliance with sponsor and grant requirements, data that stays usable for a decade or more, and budgets that have to stretch further every year.

You will be the technical lead on these accounts, working alongside account managers, specialists, and partners to build solutions customers can defend internally, both technically and financially.

Location: MD / VA

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Develop a real understanding of what drives each institution: research priorities, funding cycles, capital versus operating constraints, and who actually makes the decision

• Connect technology, including the Everpure portfolio and the broader ecosystem, to measurable research and institutional outcomes

• Move fluently between principal investigators, research computing staff, central IT, CIOs, finance, and procurement, adapting the conversation to each audience instead of delivering the same presentation

• Build the business case alongside the technical one: total cost of ownership, power and cooling, data center footprint, staff time, and the real cost of the current environment

• Support research workloads end to end, from instrument and sequencer output through HPC and AI pipelines to long-term retention and archive

• Help customers work through data management questions: lifecycle and retention, reproducibility, sponsor and funding agency data sharing expectations, research data governance, and security requirements such as NIST 800-171 and CMMC where they apply

• Partner closely with account managers, specialists, channel partners, and higher education purchasing consortia and contract vehicles

• Take ownership of evaluations, benchmarks, proofs of concept, and system configurations, and secure the technical win

• Capture requirements and translate them into solutions that help institutions grow their research capability rather than just their capacity

• Author responses to RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs, which in this segment are frequent and detailed

• Stay current on the competitive landscape and make sure our positioning reflects it honestly

• Follow market and research computing trends closely enough to bring that thinking back into our organization

• Lead by example living the Pure Values: Persistence, Creativity, Teamwork, Ownership and Customer-first

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Required

• 8 or more years of relevant experience across technology, solution design, and customer-facing communication

title: Senior Database Administrator (DBA)
description:
At Yuno , we are building the payment infrastructure that helps companies grow across Latin America and beyond. We are looking for a Senior Database Administrator to join our Engineering team and take ownership of the reliability, performance, and scalability of our database systems.
This is a senior, remote role for someone who thrives on solving complex data infrastructure challenges and wants to make a direct impact on a fast-growing payments platform. You will work closely with our current DBA and Engineering leadership, helping to strengthen our database operations and after-hours deployment support coverage.
We are looking for someone based in a timezone that complements our Bogota-based team (for example, Mexico or Europe), and who is fluent in both English and Spanish.
What you will do

• Own the performance, availability, and scalability of our production database systems (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB)

• Design, implement, and maintain backup, replication, and disaster recovery strategies

• Lead database deployments, migrations, and schema changes with minimal downtime

• Provide after-hours and on-call support for critical deployments, sharing coverage with the rest of the team

• Monitor database health and proactively resolve performance bottlenecks

• Partner with Engineering to design scalable data architectures for new features

• Establish and enforce best practices for security, access control, and data governance

• Document database processes and mentor other engineers on database best practices

What you will bring

• 5+ years of experience as a Database Administrator or similar senior data infrastructure role

• Strong hands-on expertise with PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB in production environments

• Solid experience with backup and disaster recovery strategies, replication, and high-availability setups

• Experience supporting production deployments, including after-hours or on-call rotations

• Comfortable working independently in a remote, distributed team spanning multiple timezones

• Strong troubleshooting and performance-tuning skills under pressure

• Fluent in both English and Spanish, written and spoken

• Based in Mexico, Europe, or a similar timezone that complements a Bogota-based team

• Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering

At Yuno , you will join a passionate, fast-moving team building the future of payments infrastructure in Latin America. We value ownership, technical excellence, and clear communication across our distributed team. title: Principal AI Delivery Lead
description:
EBSCO Information Services (EBSCO) delivers a fully optimized research experience, seamlessly integrated with a powerful discovery platform to support the information needs and maximize the research experience of our end-users. Headquartered in Ipswich, MA, EBSCO employs more than 2,700 people worldwide, with most embracing hybrid or remote work models. EBSCO is standing up a forward-deployed AI delivery capability inside its Data & AI organization - a small pod structure that turns real business problems into production AI systems and hands them back to the teams that own them. We are hiring a Delivery Lead to lead it.
This is a player-coach role for someone who can set technical direction for agentic AI systems, run a disciplined intake → build → hand-off delivery model, and build repeatable internal capabilities. You will lead a team of AI Engineers and partner with sponsors across Product, Security, Customer Service, and Operations to ship AI that measurably moves speed, quality, and cost. Just as important, you will leave behind reusable patterns, evaluations, and guardrails that let the rest of EBSCO move faster. You will join at the ground floor of a funded, executive-sponsored team with a live backlog waiting on day one!
What You'll Do

• Lead the Forward-Deployed Engineering pod: Own the outcomes, the delivery roadmap, and the growth and performance of the team

• Run the operating model: Score inbound demand on value / feasibility / data-risk, time-box engagements, and enforce a clean hand-off so the receiving team can own, operate, and extend what you build

• Set technical direction for production agentic systems: Orchestration and long-running workflows, RAG / enterprise search, human-in-the-loop, governed tool and data access (e.g., MCP), and bring-your-own-model patterns

• Stand up the delivery foundations: An evaluation harness, responsible-AI guardrails, LLM observability, and a reusable pattern catalog that compounds across engagements

• Own cost-to-serve: Model selection, small-language-model migration, prompt caching, and token economics

• Partner with named business sponsors to convert their use cases into shipped, adopted systems

• Work alongside strategic delivery vendors as accelerants while protecting EBSCO IP ownership

• Instrument and report impact on a Speed / Quality / Cost / Learning scorecard and communicate back to SLT

• Scale the capability: Mature the pod and seed the embedded champion (“spoke”) network so applied-AI delivery scales without the central team becoming the bottleneck
Your Team
You will lead the Forward-Deployed Engineering (FDE) team, the delivery engine of EBSCO’s AI operating model, within the Data & AI Organization (DAIO), reporting to the VP, Head of AI. You will work the enterprise’s highest-value applied-AI and automation use cases, backed by a standing backlog, direct executive sponsorship, and a clear mandate to define how AI delivery gets done at EBSCO. This is a build-it role, with the autonomy that comes with it.
About You

• 10+ years in software, product, or AI delivery, including 3+ years leading teams that shipped AI-powered production software

• Demonstrated ownership of production AI/ML or generative-AI systems end-to-end from solution design through production rollout and adoption not just prototypes or strategy decks

• Hands-on fluency with modern agentic AI such as LLM orchestration, RAG / vector search, human-in-the-loop design, prompt engineering, and agent evaluation

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As an Onboarding Expert, you’ll be a key contributor to an excellent onboarding journey for new and reactivated workers on our app. You’ll guide them, cheer them on, solve blockers, and help them take their first step to making a difference.

- Identify pain points and opportunities for improvement in the worker experience.

- Be the go-to guide and trusted partner helping professionals feel confident, supported, and ready to work their first shift.

WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT

- You enjoy talking to people, helping them succeed, solving challenges, and getting them excited about Clipboard.

- You’re comfortable making calls in a phone-heavy, fast-paced environment and love building rapport quickly.

- You speak and write English clearly and professionally.

- You’re organized, follow through on tasks, and don’t let things slip.

- You’re curious, resourceful, and always looking for the root cause of a problem.

- You’re quick with tools and not afraid to learn new systems.

- You’re observant, recognize pain points and opportunities, and aren't afraid to step in and lead the charge on improvements.

- Able to work weekdays in US Eastern Time.

title: Senior Mechanical Enigneer
description:

Quartermaster is building the world's most comprehensive maritime intelligence platform. Our SmartMast™ system transforms commercial and civilian vessels into a persistent, distributed sensing network-combining HD video, AI, radar, RF sensing, and AIS to deliver real-time maritime domain awareness at global scale. We are seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer to design and release hardware for Quartermaster’s Smartmast systems and related marine products. This role focuses on marine electromechanical hardware for harsh outdoor environments, especially enclosures, mounting systems, cable integration, and production-ready design.

- Strong CAD proficiency, preferably in Onshape, with the ability to create production-ready parts and assemblies.

- Ability to work independently and communicate clearly with remote teams, vendors, and manufacturing partners.

- Industrial design experience is a plus.

- Occasional travel to vessel installations or manufacturing sites.

- Opportunity to work on innovative projects with a global impact.

• Забезпечувати, щоб доопрацювання беклогу командою узгоджувалося зі стратегією та пріоритетами продукту, валідуючи результати.

• Співпрацювати з Product Management та стейкхолдерами для вдосконалення функцій продукту на основі підтверджених ринкових та клієнтських інсайтів.

• Координувати роботу бізнес-аналітиків, системних аналітиків та інших ролей на етапі дослідження (discovery), забезпечуючи чіткість та технічну реалізованість вимог.

• Брати участь та співкерувати ретроспективами спринтів разом з EM, ініціюючи покращення командних практик.

• Керувати процесом виявлення ризиків та шляхами ескалації (PO визначає продуктові ризики → EM керує ризиками постачання).

• Координувати крос-командні епіки та забезпечувати узгодженість щодо спільного функціоналу.

• Працювати з інструментом Estimator, отримувати погодження та підтримувати процес оцінювання (EM оцінює → PO/DM погоджує).

Вимоги:

• 3+ роки досвіду на позиції Product Owner, Product Manager, Delivery Manager або на подібних ролях

• 2+ роки досвіду у сфері Pharma, Life Sciences або фармацевтичного маркетингу (в IT/tech середовищі) - процеси та системи ланцюга постачання контенту (створення контенту, MLR, CRM, Veeva, AEM, SFDC)

• Досвід роботи з продуктами на основі AI/ML, включно з розумінням життєвого циклу моделей, метрик оцінювання та обмежень, таких як упередженість (bias) та галюцинації

• Впевнене володіння Jira, Confluence та методологіями Agile/Scrum

• Досвід написання user stories, критеріїв приймання (acceptance criteria) та технічних специфікацій

• Знання технік оцінювання (story points, T-shirt sizing)

• Рівень англійської мови - Upper-Intermediate або вище

Що ми пропонуємо?
Команда має для нас велике значення, тому ми цінуємо її та надаємо можливість кожному ділитися своїм бачен

You can be fully remote, based in the United States, preferably in San Francisco.

WHY THIS ROLE?

Langfuse has grown mostly through product-led, open-source adoption. We built a strong product, wrote useful docs and examples, stayed close to users, shipped in public, and helped developers understand how to build better AI applications.

However, many of the highest-signal moments happen in person: hallway conversations, workshops, meetups, dinners, conference demos, and technical talks.

We want someone who can own that motion end to end; put Langfuse in the right AI engineering rooms, make the product clear to technical audiences, and turn in-person conversations into durable marketing momentum.

The goal is not to do every event. The goal is to make the right events excellent, scalable, and measurable.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

title: Senior Software Engineer, Quality
description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production - safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, https://www.gpbullhound.com/articles/top-100-next-unicorns-the-uk-france-and-germany-lead-with-the-most-promising-technology-companies-in-europe/ 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ https://page.camunda.com/wp-2025-gartner-magic-quadrant-for-boat for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies https://flexa.careers/companies/camunda, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Quality to build the agentic layer of how Camunda tests its software.

We treat quality as an engineering discipline. We build test infrastructure the way we build our product - real design decisions, real trade-offs, real ownership. What's changing is how that work gets done: we're moving from hand-written test suites toward agents that design, generate, maintain and triage tests across the lifecycle. We need someone to build both the agents and the infrastructure that makes them dependable, and to help shape our Quality AI strategy.

You'll support product teams that ship features without dedicated QA. Your job is not to become their testing safety net. It's to build the tooling and practices that let builders own quality themselves - and to stay close enough to real features to know where that tooling breaks.

Camunda also ships AI capabilities in its own product, so the evaluation practice you build for agent-driven testing feeds directly into how we test non-deterministic features.

You'll join colleagues who live our FAITH values: Focus, Ambition, Integrity, Talent and Humor.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk https://www.camundacon.com/event-session/camundacon-amsterdam-2025/one-exporter-to-rule-them-all-exploring-camunda-exporter/?on_demand=true from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing:

-  Build and operate agents across the testing lifecycle - test design, generation, maintenance, execution and failure triage.

- Own the infrastructure that makes agent-driven testing reliable: environments, test data, tool interfaces, guardrails, runtime and cost control.

- Define how we measure agent output quality, so teams can trust results instead of hand-reviewing them.

- Apply that evaluation practice to testing Camunda 8's own AI capabilities.

- Work hands-on with new features as teams build them, enough to keep the tooling honest.

- Raise the quality capability of teams - patterns, tooling, enablement. Success is what builders can do themselves, not the number of tests you wrote.

What You Bring:

- Ability and/or willingness to use our product https://accounts.cloud.camunda.io/signup?_ga=2.47330343.127558761.1654184528-504024057.1654184528

-  5+ years as a software engineer. You write production code daily and would be credible on a product team; quality is your domain, not a step do

title: Manager, Applied AI Architect (India)
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Applied AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Manager of Applied AI Architects, you will lead a team of senior technical leaders responsible for the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value for OpenAI's largest and most complex customers. Your team will act as the “CTO of the book of business,” partnering with customer executives and technical teams from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.

You will set the operating model for how Applied AI Architects own technical account plans across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In close partnership with Sales leadership and Account Directors, you will help prioritize customer portfolios, allocate technical resources, and ensure business priorities translate into focused use cases, credible architectures, actionable adoption roadmaps, and durable customer value and growth.

You will remain accountable for the team's technical outcomes while developing its people and bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, research, and partners. - Partner with Sales leadership and Account Directors to prioritize accounts and opportunities, allocate technical resources effectively, and establish clear technical strategies for the region's most consequential engagements.

- Ensure Applied AI Architects serve as the primary technical advisors for their portfolios, owning technical account plans, technical milestones, adoption priorities, account health, and expansion opportunities.

- Lead complex, multi-threaded customer journeys that connect executive vision and business outcomes with use-case qualification, solution evaluation, enterprise governance, and a credible path to production.

- Coach the team on Applied AI architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, identity, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, reliability, and deployment.

- Build trusted relationships with C-suite and board-level stakeholders, as well as senior AI, technology, data, security, and engineering leaders, serving as an executive technical sponsor when needed.

- Mobilize Deployment Engineering, implementation, enablement, Product, Engineering, Research, Security, Legal, Privacy, partners, and other specialists to remove blockers and deliver a cohesive customer experience.

- Establish a rigorous view of portfolio health, including technical wins, qualified use cases, production readiness, adoption, usage, risks, measurable customer impact, and the technical contribution to growth.

- Translate patterns from the field into actionable feedback for Product,

title: Teamleiter Immobilienverwaltung (m/w/d)
description:
ÜBER BUENA

Buena baut die Technologie, auf der die Immobilienbranche läuft. Wir machen jeden Teil der Immobilienwirtschaft so nahtlos und transparent wie möglich, vom Finden über das Finanzieren bis zum Verwalten.

Dafür übernehmen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und bauen sie zu Technologieunternehmen um. In den letzten drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 30 Leuten im HQ zu Deutschlands zweitgrößtem Immobilienverwalter geworden.

ÜBER DIE ROLLE

Du kennst den Alltag einer Hausverwaltung und weißt, wie du Ordnung reinbringst, wenn Abläufe stocken, Aufgaben liegen bleiben oder Verantwortlichkeiten unklar sind.

Genau dort setzt du bei Buena an. Jeden Monat übernehmen wir neue Hausverwaltungen, und du überführst sie in den Buena-Betrieb. Deine Basis ist unser Büro in Berlin, deine Einsätze finden in unseren Verwaltungen in ganz Deutschland statt. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich in funktionierenden Abläufen und in Teams, die mit der Buena App besser arbeiten als vorher.

VERANTWORTLICHKEITEN

- Du arbeitest im Tagesgeschäft unserer Verwaltungen mit, erkennst Engpässe früh und baust Rückstände ab. Vor und nach der Umstellung auf die Buena App.

- Du schaffst mit den Teams klare Zuständigkeiten und Prozesse, die auch nach deinem Einsatz Bestand haben.

- Du kennst unsere Software in- und auswendig und trainierst die Teams an ihren konkreten Aufgaben.

- Du bringst deine Erfahrungen aus dem Verwaltungsalltag zurück ins Product-Team. Was du vor Ort siehst, macht unsere App besser.

DU PASST GUT, WENN DU

- Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Immobilienverwaltung mitbringst und das Tagesgeschäft eigenständig beherrschst.

- Probleme schnell erkennst, Prioritäten setzt und selbst mit anpackst.

- Klar kommunizierst, schnell Vertrauen aufbaust und Menschen für neue Arbeitsweisen gewinnst.

- Tech-affin bist. Neue Software lernst du schnell und erklärst sie so, dass anderen die Arbeit leichter fällt.

- Bereit bist, regelmäßig bei unseren Verwaltungen in ganz Deutschland vor Ort zu arbeiten, je nach Einsatz auch mehrere Tage am Stück.

- Fließend Deutsch sprichst.

DEINE BENEFITS

- Bis zu 500 € Close-to-Office-Bonus, wenn du 10 bis 20 Gehminuten vom Büro entfernt wohnst.

- 110 €/Monat Lunch-Budget, 50 € Fitness-Zuschuss.

- 1.200 € jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget.

- Kostenlose Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen möchtest.

WARUM JETZT EINSTEIGEN

- Du bist die Person vor Ort: Jede Verwaltung, die wir übernehmen, wird erst durch dich zu einem Buena-Betrieb. Ohne dich bleibt sie, was sie war.

- Wir wachsen schnell: Jeden Monat kommen neue Hausverwaltungen dazu. Deine Einsätze werden nicht weniger, sondern größer.

- Wir sind meritokratisch: Wer liefert, bekommt Verantwortung. Unser CEO war vor drei Jahren Junior Product Manager, unser COO vor zwei Jahren Chief of Staff.

- Wir verändern eine ganze Branche: Die deutsche Hausverwaltung läuft noch auf Papier und Excel. Du stellst das vor Ort um.

description:

Who we are
Our work matters - robotics is transforming the world of commerce. Every day our intelligent robots are responsible for getting food and merchandise to thousands of stores across North America. We’re an industry changer - we created the first and only fully autonomous, end-to-end supply chain solution.
Today, we are driving towards even bigger ideas - and we have the people, technology, and leadership to fully realize these aspirations. We have the excitement and ambition of a startup with the benefits and resources of a proven organization.
What you'll do
We are seeking a Senior Industrial Controls Programmer. The candidate is part of our Industrial Automation team and will be reporting to the Senior Manager Industrial Controls Engineering and have a leadership role in driving the execution of the PLC development and implementation. The ideal candidate is customer driven and proactive fetching information and discuss with the end user.
